name: The Charge of the Dragonflights
summary: In Tanaris, Anachronos meets you as the first part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands draws to a close. The chain leads toward the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

sections.title: The End of the Beginning
sections.body: Anachronos meets you in Tanaris to close the first part of the Scepter of the Shifting Sands. The chain leads toward the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj.

sections.title: The Three Watchers
sections.body:
Anachronos names Eranikus, Vaelastrasz and Azuregos as three dragons who watched over the world. Each has suffered tragedy at the hands of agents of the Old Gods or through betrayal by those they called friend.

Anachronos admits his own naivety made him partly to blame. These events have fed his distrust of mortals, so he sends you to seek the three dragons and prepare for the worst.

faq.answer: Anachronos is a dragon of the bronze dragonflight whom you meet in Tanaris.

faq.q: What is the Scepter of the Shifting Sands?
faq.answer: The Scepter of the Shifting Sands is a long chain leading toward the opening of the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. Your meeting with Anachronos closes its first part.
